title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — October 28, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 407 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Nice and quiet out there. 🌎☀️

Several bright active regions and a broad darker coronal area are visible today, with no clear large outward structure in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
